understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete every level by moving each selectable piece onto a goal tile marked +; when multiple goals existed, all had to be occupied simultaneously. The run did not finish because the final attempt ended before solving the level.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved one grid cell per directional action, with coordinates represented in pixel/grid positions. Selectable pieces could be switched using CLICK on their exact object coordinates. Adjacent pushable blocks could move when pushed, while walls and boundaries could block or behave differently; movement-blocked hints were only heuristic and actions had to be tested. Efficient planning was necessary because each level had a finite step budget and limited attempts.
